plan.what: Validate that IMAGE_PATH is set and points to an existing file, then store it for later steps.
plan.fails_if: IMAGE_PATH is missing or the file does not exist.

plan.what: Create a PDF, add a bold title, embed the image below the title, then render markdown body text.
Encode the generated PDF as base64 and output JSON.
plan.fails_if: Encoding fails or no output is produced.

notes: Maturation rubric: Add a TITLE line above the image on the first page. Title uses Helvetica-Bold at size 24. Body text (if any) uses Helvetica at size 12. The image must still appear directly below the title on the same page. All other behavior identical to v1.
